run_create_samples_cli: run the script with --viz-dir to create annotation sample directories from run_data.json episodes
create_samples_function: create sample directories with shuffled episodes split across multiple annotation directories with optional overlap
parse_arguments_cli: parse command line args for viz-dir, sample-size, num-directories, and overlap-samples parameters
create_samples_subset: create a random subset of episodes by specifying --sample-size to limit visualization scope
create_samples_overlap: create multiple annotation directories sharing common episodes via the --overlap-samples parameter
